name: InterContinental Madrid
insider_take: This luxury flagship sits in the heart of Madrid's prestigious Salamanca district, where Michelin-starred dining meets world-class shopping along the famous Golden Mile.
whats_special: The InterContinental Madrid occupies a prime position on Paseo de la Castellana, Madrid's main financial artery, and features Spain's highest rooftop bar offering panoramic views of the Royal Palace and Retiro Park. The hotel's Club InterContinental floors provide exclusive access to one of Europe's largest hotel club lounges.
pro_tip: Book a table at the rooftop ThreeSixty restaurant during sunset – the golden hour views over Madrid's skyline are absolutely spectacular, and reservations fill up quickly.
dont_miss: The hotel is just steps from El Retiro Park's Crystal Palace and a 5-minute walk to the Prado Museum's lesser-known entrance. The nearby Mercado de la Paz offers authentic Spanish delicacies away from tourist crowds, and Calle Serrano provides luxury shopping rivaling Paris's Champs-Élysées.
pros: Prime location on Paseo de la Castellana in business district
Luxurious accommodations with elegant Spanish design
Award-winning dining and rooftop terrace with city views
cons: Business district location, not historic center
